When documenting configuration options in syntax/flowchart docs, show only the YAML frontmatter block (e.g., `---
config:
  optionName: value
---`) as the example; do not use the deprecated directive syntax or include a sample diagram body in the config snippet, since directives have been deprecated in this project.

Internal rendering functions (e.g., in `packages/mermaid/src/rendering-util/` and `packages/mermaid/src/dagre-wrapper/`) must not call or import `getConfig` directly. Instead, accept an explicit `config: MermaidConfig` parameter and thread it down from callers that already hold it. This avoids global-state pollution and supports the architectural goal of enabling parallel/async rendering.

Every new property added to `packages/mermaid/src/schemas/config.schema.yaml` must include a `default` value alongside its `type` declaration, so defaults are consistent between the schema and runtime behaviour.
Avoid `else` blocks that follow an `if` statement ending in `return`; place the fallback code directly after the `if` block (guard clause pattern) to reduce nesting and improve readability.
